image_description: A light blue and white baby bib lying flat on a textured beige carpet. The bib features a rounded shield shape with a curved neck opening, white fabric ties at the back of the neck, and a decorative border with small blue patterns. The main body has a horizontal band design containing green abstract shapes and fragmented text-like elements.
